authoring_scope: Only this new support/upl_p3_wall_publish_r1.ps1 and this note are authored; no index/source/retained result edits, no stage/commit/push by this author.
default_mode: List: read-only current exact count/bytes/missing list and path/hash candidates. No files or Git are changed.
seal_mode: Seal requires the new independent support/upl_p3_wall_review_r1.py and notes/upl_p3_wall_review_r1.json plus passed actual r4 Debug/Release wall, latest defaultOFF, periodic_r2, flux audit and current production/source-snapshot hashes. It writes one fresh immutable manifest only. Missing review is not treated as passed.
stage_mode: Root only, after reviewing exact manifest: -Mode Stage -StageAuthorized -ReviewedManifestSha256 <exact SHA>. Rechecks base and every file hash, refuses unrelated pre-existing staged files, and adds only literal manifest paths plus the manifest itself in small batches. No commit/push/reset/checkout is implemented.
scope: Three production CPU files and r1/r2/r3 source snapshots; all new non-mirror wall configs/companions/runners/build recipes and notes; key wall source/build/native/half/driver and setup-failure records; full latest defaultOFF JSON implementation receipts; r1 historical OFF build and wall summaries; periodic r1/r2 exact checks; compact saved wall/periodic modes, endpoint policy, component/offgrid/flux audits, identity CSVs and completion summaries; seed XML and frozen recipe text. Root's independently plotted figures/upl_p3_wall_r1.png and _history.csv/check/script plus the explicitly authorized validation/upl_current_status.json next_order stage update are included. Existing previously committed mirror proof is not duplicated.
raw_exclusions: No BI4/IBI4/OBI4/VTK or physical.bin; no exe/obj/pdb/DLL/lib; no per-particle observer/raw state CSVs. Original receipts still bind all local raw bytes, but cloud source/text/one-PNG backup is not raw data backup. No README/AGENTS or unrelated dirty path is selected. Root confirmed current_status HEAD difference consists only of this stage's two next_order changes; root must preserve that scope before sealing.
acceptance_scope: CPU-only private flags; static pair of axis-aligned parallel FreeSlip walls, weak elastic g=0 constant-k. Gates passed in bounded jobs do not enable public XML, general curved/moving/NoSlip/gravity walls, GPU or formal physical acceptance. Optional k(J) follows as a separate stage.
